SEARCH
Package database

Class Database

java.lang.Object
database.Database
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Database extends Object implements Serializable
Singleton database for the university system. Stores users, logs, attendance records, tech support requests, and teacher ratings. Supports serialization between sessions.
